facts.statement: Lavocatchampsa was an extinct genus of notosuchian mesoeucrocodylian found in the Late Cretaceous Kem Kem Beds of Morocco.
facts.quote: Lavocatchampsa is an extinct genus of notosuchian mesoeucrocodylian known from the Late Cretaceous Kem Kem Beds in Morocco.

facts.statement: The genus Lavocatchampsa contains only one species, Lavocatchampsa sigogneaurusselae.
facts.quote: It contains a single species, Lavocatchampsa sigogneaurusselae.

facts.statement: The genus Lavocatchampsa was named by Martin and de Lapparent de Broin in 2016.
facts.quote: parent_authority: Martin and de Lapparent de Broin, 2016

facts.statement: Lavocatchampsa is classified within the family Candidodontidae.
Lavocatchampsa lived during the Albian to Cenomanian stages, from 106.3 to 93.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Cenomanian (106.3 to 93.9 million years ago)
